name: ipfs
description: Read first bytes of any IPFS CID via a 7-gateway fallback chain (dweb.link, ipfs.io, pinata, 4everland, nftstorage, w3s, flk-ipfs). Returns content + which gateway served it + per-gateway attempts log.

gateway.description: Optional: force a specific gateway URL (e.g. https://ipfs.io).
